fit_analysis.result: Three 17-inch stools do not fit within a 48-inch run even when touching. At the current 18-inch center spacing their combined body span is 53 inches. The 30-inch seat height suits a 42-inch counter, but quantity three remains a physical mockup and circulation decision. Do not infer fit from the product being compact or backless.

installation_and_use_holds: Tape three 17-inch circles at the actual bar and operate the refrigerator door, south entry, adjacent chair and walking route.
Confirm seated knee, footrest and elbow clearance; the 48-inch bar supplies only 16 inches of run per person.
Confirm the gold finish sample against the room brass finish before ordering all three.
Retain the supplier warranty and care instructions in the closeout packet.

custom_quote.brief: Quote one 30-inch-diameter by approximately 16-inch-high round table with a smoked or black tempered-glass top, black structural base and restrained brushed-brass rim or accent. Fabricator must engineer glass thickness, edge finish, supports, stability and floor protection; field mockup controls.
custom_quote.reason: The exact-size By-Boo Bunga dimensional reference is currently out of stock in the US, and the closest orderable marketplace alternative is one inch taller with internally inconsistent material fields.

recommendation.model: Sloane Black Flatwoven Rug + Standard Pad System
recommendation.finish: tonal charcoal and grey geometric pattern with soft cream accents
recommendation.construction: 2 mm flatwoven polyester cover with waterproof barrier over required nonslip Standard Rug Pad; completed standard pad is approximately 1/8 inch thick
recommendation.stock_evidence: Ruggable structured product data reported InStock; page states made to order and ships free within 1–2 weeks.

standard_size_alternative.model: Sloane Black Flatwoven Rug + Standard Pad System
standard_size_alternative.stock_evidence: Ruggable structured product data reported InStock.

fit_analysis.recommended_difference: The 8 by 10 can orient with its 10-foot axis on the desired long axis but is one foot narrower than the approximate 10 by 9 target.
fit_analysis.alternative_difference: The 9 by 12 matches the desired 9-foot short axis but extends two feet beyond the approximate 10-foot long axis.
fit_analysis.result: No rug size changes the furniture layout. Tape both standard rectangles around the retained furniture and door/access paths, then choose the one whose actual edges remain clear. Do not trim a Ruggable system.

installation_and_use_holds: Buy the cover and same-size Standard Pad as one system; the flatwoven cover requires a pad.
Install the pad on a clean, dry hard floor, align and smooth the cover from the center outward, and keep edges out of door and rolling-chair paths.
Confirm flooring-finish compatibility with Ruggable before long-term placement.
Follow the manufacturer wash and dry limits; its guide calls for at least a 3.8 cubic-foot washer for 8 by 10 and 4.2 cubic-foot washer for 9 by 12 flatwoven covers.

television.description: 50-inch Q6-Series 4K UHD HDR QLED Smart Google TV (2024)
television.vesa_screws: M6 x 12 top pair; M6 x 16 bottom pair per TCL specification
television.stock_evidence: TCL's live product JSON mapped variant 44055800053825 to SKU 50Q651G, available true, at $299.99. Best Buy also displayed Ready Today, shipping availability and Add to cart on 2026-09-28; local inventory is location-dependent.
television.manual_status: No model-specific manual URL is asserted here. Retrieve the current 50Q651G manual from TCL support and reconcile it with the purchased unit before installation.

mount.vesa_compatibility: Universal interface includes 300 x 300 mm; compatible with the TCL 50Q651G pattern subject to SANUS model confirmation and installer review.
mount.stock_evidence: Best Buy page displayed current price and pickup/shipping availability on 2026-09-28.

fit_analysis.cabinet_result: The 50Q651G cabinet exactly matches the current modeled reference envelope.
fit_analysis.mount_change: The candidate and canonical verified reference both use 300 by 300 mm VESA. The purchased unit, current model-specific manual, mount and field template still control exact hole and blocking coordination.
fit_analysis.assembled_depth_note: Nominal TV depth plus mount offset only; connector bend radius, wall flatness, bracket geometry and cable access can increase the real projection.

installation_and_use_holds: The candidate uses the same cabinet envelope, so the accepted 3D representation can remain unchanged; identify 50Q651G explicitly in the procurement record.
At M-13, template the purchased TV body, 300 by 300 VESA pattern, bracket, cable exits, power/data path, service lift and all instrument removal arcs.
Confirm wall substrate and blocking with the installer. Follow the SANUS manual for the actual wood-stud, concrete or approved wall condition; never infer anchors from this research.
The 0.67-inch mount is very shallow. Prove plug and connector clearance before drilling, and use rated in-wall power/data methods rather than loose concealed cords.
Follow TCL screw sizes and SANUS spacer selection; verify screw engagement on the purchased TV without bottoming out.
Confirm final body-to-guitar clearances after the mount projection is known.
